TEXT:
After getting word from Kuroneko, the 
long-awaited day of our date has finally arrived. So, 
we're meeting at...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Why is it in front of the school's gate?

Normally it'll be at the train station... I'd rather meet 
you at your house too.

I thought about that since I arrived a little early in 
front of the school gate. Then, I doubted what I 
saw, if but just for a moment.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It appears that you have arrived.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Kuroneko...san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Heh... Wrong.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Right now, I'm the "Holy Angel Kamineko". From 
the family of darkness, I have been reborn as a 
white angel.

My question was answered by the full throttle of 
Chuunibyou nonsense.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No... You're Kuroneko, no matter how you look at it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Tch, didn't I say that's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No no, Kuroneko. What on earth is with that get-up-

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You're repetitive.

Seems like I won't get through to her if I don't 
play along.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Alright, Kamineko...san? There's something I wish to 
know, is that okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Fufu, what is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What's with that get-up?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: It is the garments of the Holy Angel.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Since when did you...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I started working on it since the day we went 
shellfish gathering.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: You only took two days?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
One thing led to another, I spent two sleepless 
nights making it.
...She worked that hard on it, huh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: And so... How about it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Do you not have any thoughts after seeing this 
outfit?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...You look cute.

It had a certain kind of eccentric charm compared 
to her usual Gothic Lolita outfit, this has its own 
unique flavor to it. However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But, those wings and such... what's with those?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
After the class change from a Fallen Angel into a 
Holy Angel, it materialized itself as a symbol.
I can't understand any of this... Hang on.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
You're not going on a date today dressed like that, 
are you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Of course, I plan to. Is there a problem?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It looks good on you, but wouldn't that stand out a 
bit too much?

Going on a date with that outfit... That's pretty 
tough.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...I'll go change out of this and come back.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, you don't have to change...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: But you look so troubled over it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Urgh...
Crap, so it was written all over my face...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Anyway, just wait here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...At least let me walk you home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: You can't.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: After all... isn't that more befitting for a date?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Did I just say something I shouldn't have?

It looks like that outfit was made for the sake of 
showing it to me.

But stuff like going on a first date with my 
girlfriend cosplaying as an angel with wings 
attached, it's beyond me.

Still, Kuroneko's pretty cute in that outfit too, so I 
should encourage her to wear that again sometime.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...It appears that you have arrived.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Huh? Erm, didn't you say that earlie... eh? Umm, 
Kuroneko...san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Do I look like anyone else to you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, that outfit...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: W-What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What kind of cosplay is it this time?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
I-It's not cosplay... it's just normal clothes, casual 
clothing...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: S-Sorry.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: And so... How about it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: What?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Do you not have any thoughts after seeing this 
outfit?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...You look cute.

This conversation is giving me a huge sense of Déjà 
vu somehow... Could it be she's shrugging off what 
happened earlier?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
It's quite a different impression from before 
though... I didn't know you have such clothes too.

It's certainly cute, but quite different from the 
usual Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: ...This outfit was picked out by your sister, you know.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: By Kirino?

I see. As expected from her modeling experience. 
With just clothes, an impression is easily changed...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, I'm glad you two seem to be getting along.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Hmph, I wish you wouldn't take our friendship that 
lightly.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I see. Thanks.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...W-Well, let us be off, then. We're taking the train, 
aren't we?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nah, we won't be taking the train today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Aren't we going to Akihabara like usual?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
If so, it'll be the same as before we started dating, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: That... that might be true...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
Besides, wouldn't it be useful for your stories? 
Knowing what lovers normally do on a date?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...In other words, you wish to go on a "normal date" 
with me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: That's one way to put it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Goodness, even though there are some shops that I 
would like to visit at Akihabara today...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...I guess you would prefer it if it's Akihabara?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I never said anything of the sort.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: But you just...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
As long as you're together with me, I'll be happy 
no matter where we go, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
Well, these experiences are good from time to time. 
You'll give me a proper escort in return, won't you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, yeah, of course!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
That's... Hey, how about stuff like a pilgrimage to 
the holy land of Anime!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
That isn't really a place where you would go on a 
date with a lover...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Urgh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
...Well, I can't blame you. It's not like you just started 
being pitiable today.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: I like that part of you too, you know?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: What? Are you blushing?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: ...Leave me alone.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Oh my, are you sulking already?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: I'm not sulking at all!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Hehe.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: So, where do we go first then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: For starters, let's head towards the station.

I started walking alongside Kuroneko, our steps 
matching.
